title: AMAQA: A Metadata-based QA Dataset for RAG Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) evaluations of 450 RAG-generated responses against human reviews to validate its reliability and check for preferences toward longer responses.
Calculating agreement between GPT-4o's evaluations and human annotators on LLM-generated responses to ensure the evaluator model does not unfairly favor LLM-generated text.
